title: Nik Bonitto says continued growth as a player "has nothing to do with the physical part"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Nik Bonitto says continued growth as a player "has nothing to do with the physical part"
sources.description: Broncos linebacker Nik Bonitto had a career-high 14 sacks last season despite playing almost the whole year with a large cast over his right hand and wrist.
